claims.text: Conrad Punta de Mita sits where the jungle meets the sea, in the heart of the Riviera Nayarit.

findings.quote: Nestled where the jungle meets the sea, Conrad Punta de Mita sits at the heart of the Riviera Nayarit
findings.note: Matches the location description.

claims.text: The resort is set on a mile of white-sand beach.

findings.quote: Set on a mile of white-sand beach, Conrad Punta de Mita slid under the radar when it first opened
findings.note: States a mile of white-sand beach.

claims.text: The resort is in the Litibú gated community, among towering palm trees.

findings.quote: Conrad Punta de Mita is set amidst towering palm trees in the Litibú gated community.
findings.note: Covers both palm trees and the Litibú gated community.

claims.text: The resort's design is subtly inspired by local Huichol culture, with built-in Huichol motifs.

findings.quote: Contemporary and fresh by design, the resort is subtly inspired by the local Huichol culture, with built-in motifs such as the
findings.note: Describes subtle Huichol inspiration with built-in motifs.

claims.text: The Ocean View Penthouse Suite has an oversized balcony with a plunge pool and a hammock.

findings.quote: Incredibly spacious yet intimate, our Penthouse Suite offers unrivaled seclusion with personal concierge services and an oversized balcony with plunge pool and hammock.
findings.note: Describes the Ocean View Penthouse Suite King Bed with Plunge Pool.

claims.text: Two-bedroom residence suites are designed for families or entertaining, with a full kitchen and personal concierge services.

findings.quote: Designed for families or entertaining, this spacious suite features personal concierge services as well as all the amenities of a full kitchen.
findings.note: Describes the Ocean View Two Bedroom Residence Suite with Kitchen.

claims.text: With the Compadre Concierge service, a personal Compadre reaches out before arrival to learn guests' preferences.

findings.quote: Your Compadre reaches out in advance to understand your preferences, passions, and pace.
findings.note: Describes pre-arrival outreach by the Compadre.

findings.quote: Before arrival, they will connect to learn your preferences and special requests
findings.note: Confirms pre-arrival contact to learn preferences.

claims.text: At the Agave Studio, an agave expert leads tastings from more than 200 bottles of tequila, mezcal, raicilla and sotol.

findings.quote: Our agave expert will guide you through a tasting selected from our 200-plus bottles of tequila, mezcal, raicilla, and sotol.
findings.note: Covers the expert, the 200-plus bottles and all four spirits.

claims.text: The main pool area is joined by a central infinity-style pool.

findings.quote: split straight down the middle and conjoined by a central infinity-style pool
findings.note: Pool areas are joined by a central infinity-style pool.

claims.text: A kid-friendly pool has a waterslide, next to a splash pad pool with water fountains.

findings.quote: the area is adjacent to a kid-friendly pool replete with a chicly-disguised waterslide and a splash pad pool with water fountains.
findings.note: Covers the waterslide pool and the splash pad pool.

claims.text: Higuera Golf Club, designed by Greg Norman, is just steps from the resort.

findings.quote: Just steps from the resort, Higuera Golf Club is a bucket list destination for many golfers. Designed by Greg Norman,
findings.note: Covers both the proximity and the designer.

claims.text: Codex, the signature restaurant, serves seasonal specialties such as smoked Pacific oysters, crispy soft-shell crab and steamed lamb barbacoa.

findings.quote: Seasonal specialties include smoked Pacific oysters, crispy soft-shell crab, and steamed lamb barbacoa.
findings.note: This appears on the Codex page, which is titled as the signature restaurant.

claims.text: Beachfront Grand Suites have a private plunge pool, an oceanfront balcony and personal concierge services.

findings.quote: Enjoy a private plunge pool, oceanfront balcony, personal concierge services, and more.
findings.note: Describes the Beachfront Grand Suite King Bed with Plunge Pool.

claims.text: Conrad Spa is shaped by the traditions of the Wixárika (Huichol) people.

findings.quote: Conrad Spa is a sanctuary shaped by the living traditions of the Wixárika (Huichol) people
findings.note: Direct match.

claims.text: The temazcal ritual is led by a local shaman, who heats stones on a fire outside the chamber.

findings.quote: you’ll be led by a local shaman (healer), who warms stones on a fire outside, brings them in to warm up the temazcal
findings.note: Covers the shaman and heating the stones outside.

claims.text: Outdoor massage nests place treatment tables in a domed, thatched room for privacy and a connection to nature.

findings.quote: Immerse yourself in an outdoor oasis, where massage tables reside in a dome thatched room, offering privacy and a connection to nature.
findings.note: Direct match.

claims.text: Rooms and suites blend modern design and local culture, with Huichol-inspired art, private terraces and ocean views.

findings.quote: our rooms and suites offer an interwoven tapestry of modern design and local culture, furnished with Huichol-inspired art, private terraces, and unspoiled ocean views.
findings.note: Covers all listed elements.

claims.text: Punta de Mita, where the resort is, is separate from Punta Mita, the peninsula enclave on the opposite, north end of the peninsula.

findings.quote: Punta de Mita is separate from Punta Mita, an exclusive peninsula enclave punctuated by popular resorts such as Four Seasons and St. Regis that rests on the opposite, north end of the peninsula
findings.note: Direct match.

claims.text: Puerto Vallarta Airport is about 45 minutes away, and the surf town of Sayulita is about a 20-minute drive.

findings.quote: Puerto Vallarta Airport – 45 minutes
findings.note: Covers the airport distance.

findings.quote: Sayulita, a mere 20-minute drive from the resort, is renowned as a surf mecca
findings.note: Covers the Sayulita drive time and its surf-town character.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes that the remote location requires travel planning for off-property activities.
